results.title: Bamse and the Secret of the Sea
results.overview: Bamse, Little Skutt and Skalman go out into open water and far down to the bottom of the sea. And Captain Buster is willing to do anything to earn the title of Terror of the Sea.

results.title: Endless Cookie
results.overview: Exploring the complex bond between two half brothers — one Indigenous, one white — traveling from the present in isolated Shamattawa to bustling 1980s Toronto.

results.title: Radio Hell
results.overview: Chad finds a vintage CB Radio which picks up a signal revealing a secret government conspiracy.

results.title: Lonely
results.overview: After decades of living in isolation, an 80-year-old woman makes one last effort to connect with others, embarking on a life-changing journey that includes unexpected love and the possibility of reconciliation with her estranged daughter.

results.title: My Family and Other Clowns
results.overview: For 25 years, world-famous Estonian clowns Haide and Toomas, better known as Piip and Tuut, have brought joy and laughter to children and families across the globe. But behind the face paint and curtain lies a different story. While entertaining thousands, their own children – Emma, Siim, and Anni – have been growing up at home without them. Eldest daughter Emma dreams of following in her parents' footsteps, but balancing her passion for theatre with caring for her autistic brother and younger sister has forced her to grow up fast. Meanwhile, Haide and Toomas grapple with guilt, exhaustion, and the toll of trying to give their all both on stage and at home.

results.title: Daagi
results.overview: Nishan spent more than twelve years behind bars. The story begins as he steps out of prison, only to find that the world he left behind has changed drastically. Society refuses to accept him as one of its own. Thus begins Nishan's struggle to survive in an unfamiliar world.

results.title: Young & Fine
results.overview: In a quiet seaside town, high school students Haino and Reiko are dating. They try to go further than just kissing, but fail due to a condition set by Reiko: Haino must win his next rugby match to earn her consent. Motivated by this goal, Haino devotes himself to the game—until a new woman catches his eye: Izawa, a substitute teacher at their school. When Reiko sees Izawa getting close to Haino, she becomes consumed with jealousy.

results.title: Heart Flutters
results.overview: A father, a daughter and a dog. A date, bullying and car rides. These are some of the ingredients in this moving and heartbreaking drama about surviving against all odds.

results.title: Australian Chamber Orchestra's 50th Gala
results.overview: Hosted by Jeremy Fernandez and Megan Burslem, this concert showcases why the Australian Chamber Orchestra is one of the most distinct, inventive and renowned ensembles on the world stage today.

results.title: Midday UFO
results.overview: Moon-ju has arranged to meet Jae-heung, a journalist she has always admired. Suddenly, Jae-heung asks her if she believes in UFOs.

results.title: Pinocchio and the Water of Life
results.original_title: Pinocchio and the Water of Life
results.overview: Pinocchio and his sidekick Coot try to save his puppet friends from the villainous Faustino—who livestreams their destruction in nightly pay-per-view events.

results.title: Stardom in Imabari-Ehime 2025
results.overview: Stardom in Imabari-Ehime 2025 was a professional wrestling event produced by World Wonder Ring Stardom, held on December 20, 2025, at Texport Imabari in Imabari, Ehime, Japan.

results.title: Fliegengewicht
results.overview: Levi is 17 and alone in his room. When his brother stops by—broad, confident, his father's favorite—Levi suddenly feels too thin for this world. While trying on clothes, his gaze lingers on his own silhouette. Through quiet moments and casual comments, the film tells a subtle story about body image, insecurity, and the question: When are you actually "enough"?

results.title: Clay and fat
results.overview: Ricardo and his friends discover that the mother of one of them may be a prostitute. The conversation will become darker when one of them makes a suggestion. Friendship and moral boundaries are tested.

results.title: Het Grote Offensief
results.overview: The two rival Allied commanders, General Eisenhower and Field Marshal Montgomery,  clash in a battle of egos and strategic choices, with devastating consequences for the people of Zeeland during the liberation of the Netherlands.

results.title: Blood Sugar
results.overview: When an HMO-insured, Gen Z vampire is diagnosed with diabetes, she has to make lifestyle changes– beginning with breaking into a weight loss clinic, and bleeding them of their stash of “O.”

results.title: Mimpi Matahari
results.overview: Matahari grew up in a modest family. She has a younger sister named Bulan. Matahari accidentally lost Bulan's only pair of shoes. Feeling responsible, she sets out to find the shoes for the sake of her sister's happiness. Faced with limited financial means, she must struggle and find a way to earn the money needed to buy a new pair.

results.title: Thetta
results.overview: Set in a hillside village on the edge of a dense forest, this survival thriller follows Shankaran, a young man haunted by a past wild boar attack. When his friends get trapped during a hunt, Shankaran must confront his deepest fears. As the group faces nature`s wrath and a deadly wild boar, the film unravels a gripping tale of survival and courage in the heart of the wilderness.

results.title: It Would Be Night in Caracas
results.original_title: Aún es de Noche en Caracas
results.overview: While struggling to withstand the chaos of modern Venezuela, Adelaida sees a chance to survive—and takes it: leaving everything behind, even her own name. In a land with no future, her only way out is to become someone else.
